Name: Stardew Time Travel
Author: naveen000
Description:
[b][size=5]Stardew Valley Time Travel (Daily Save Rollback)[/size][/b]
Accidentally sold a legendary fish? Missed yesterday’s festival? Or made a huge planning mistake on day 28 of the season? This mod provides a complete safety net for your farm, allowing you to easily roll back to any of your last 5 mornings in your game's history.
[line]
[heading]⚙️ Key Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Time Travel (Ctrl + Shift + T):[/b] Pop open a native calendar menu in-game to select and travel back to any of your last 5 mornings.[/*]
[*][b]Full Language Support:[/b] The time travel menu dynamically reads Stardew Valley's active language and displays your backup choices as natively formatted calendar dates (e.g., Spring 5, Year 1 (Mon)).[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]⌨️ How to Use[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]To Time Travel:[/b] Press [b]Ctrl + Shift + T[/b]. A menu will open on your screen allowing you to choose which day to warp back to. Once selected, the game will reload your save, and you will wake up on that morning.[/*]
[/list]The hotkey can be fully customized inside the config.json file that generates after running the mod once.
[line]
[heading]🔒 The Safety Guarantee: Your Saves Are Safe[/heading]
We understand how important your farm progress is. This mod is built with strict architectural safeguards to ensure your original save files are never corrupted, tampered with, or broken:
[list]
[*][b]Completely Isolated Backups:[/b] Every night when you sleep, the mod copies your active save and stores it inside an isolated Backups folder inside the mod directory. It never touches Stardew Valley’s active system folders.[/*]
[*][b]Clean File-Overwrites:[/b] When you choose to Time Travel, the mod simply copies your selected historical folder from the mod directory and overwrites the files in your active Stardew save folder. This is the exact same manual method players have safely used for years to restore lost saves—automated cleanly by C# code.[/*]
[*]Your [b]latest day save[/b] will always be preserved in the Backups/ folder.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]📦 Installation Guide[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b] (version 4.0.0 or higher).[/*]
[*]Download the mod zip file and extract the downloaded mod folder directly into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]📂 File Locations[/heading]
You can manually inspect, copy, or backup your files at any time:
[list]
[*][b]Your Active Stardew Valley Saves:[/b]
C:\Users\[YourOSUsername]\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Saves\[/*]
[*][b]Your Mod Backup Timeline (Day 1 to Day 5):[/b]
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\UndoTimeTravel\Backups\[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]My Other Mods:[/size][/b]
Automate UI : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47840?tab=description
